10.hostileLabel: The drow guards in the tower see you coming.

gate.name: The pen gate
gate.locked: Heavy iron bars bolted into the stone. Locked. Picking or forcing it is a DC 20 check (OotA p.18).
gate.open: The gate stands open. Beyond it, the balcony: a rope bridge to the guard tower, and stairs down the cliff.

routes.10: Out across the rope bridge to the Guard Tower
routes.12: Down the cliff stairs to the Quaggoth Den

gray-ooze.note: to the outside of the gate, where Malachar had it (2026-10-12: it reaches the gate, touches the bars). `inside` is the chasm-side entry Malachar narrated (2026-10-13 21:28: it oozes up the stone wall from the pool below the pen) — it heaves up over the ledge at the pen's left rim, by the crystals. The approved film shows an under-the-bars entry instead; `insideGate` keeps that path for when he brings it through the gate.

inside.via: heaving itself up over the ledge from the chasm

11.wards: The wards cut into the pen's walls smother any spell cast inside it; a spell cast from outside still reaches in.

spots._note: Where a cast member goes when Malachar tags [NPC_MOVE: name | where] with this word in it. Plate pixels, matched by substring, first match wins. gate/bars = outside the pen gate where the ooze touched the bars; landing/door = Jorlan's post; bridge = the rope bridge; tower = its far end.

props.name: Ilvara's chest
props._src: OotA ch.1 area 7 (Ilvara's Quarters): 'A heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood sits at the foot of the bed.' Locked; the key is in a hidden pocket inside Ilvara's belt. Poison-needle trap on the lock, set off by any attempt to open it without the key: 1 piercing, DC 13 CON or poisoned 1 hour (fail by 5+: also unconscious). DC 20 INT (Investigation) finds it; thieves' tools + DC 15 DEX disarms it; thieves' tools + DC 15 DEX picks the lock. Traced by eye on the painted plate, 2026-10-14.

text.closed: A heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood at the foot of the bed. Locked.

lift._src: OotA ch.1 area 5: winch-and-basket on a swinging arm; up to four Medium creatures; DC 18 Strength to turn the spool (another can Help); 4 rounds between the platform and the cavern floor. Traced by eye on the painted plate, 2026-10-22.
